body:
Hey @unoscar,

I wasn't able to reproduce the behavior you described with your sandbox (the search state isn't wiped out) but looking at the code I saw that you're instantiating connected components in the body of you `App` component, which isn't good because you recreate them at every render, which may be causing the issues you've seen.

I've updated your sandbox so that connected components are outside and remain stable, and passed your function using a connected `Hits`component so I could pass extra props: https://codesandbox.io/s/exciting-oskar-f7bj3r?file=/src/App.

Does it fix the problem?
